sentences.text: Researchers applied a CRISPR-based gene activation method to target enhancers of the CHD8 and SCN2A genes in human stem cell-derived neurons and brain organoids.
This intervention caused a lasting rise in the expression of these genes within the mutant cells and organoids.
Consequently, the treatment restored normal gene expression levels and corrected physiological changes linked to the mutations.
These findings are relevant because about 15% of the genetic risk for autism spectrum disorder comes from new mutations that cause haploinsufficiency.
The authors conclude that the results support using enhancer-targeted gene activation as a potential treatment for autism and other neurodevelopmental disorders.
